title: Value a nominal forecast in constant dollars
heading: Real Dollars Pair With a Real Rate, Nominal Dollars With a Nominal Rate
cases: with zero inflation, the value is the forecast discounted at the nominal rate
nominal amounts are turned into base-year dollars before the real rate is applied
deflated amounts are discounted at the real rate, not again at the nominal rate
over a long forecast the value matches the nominal-at-nominal value to a billionth, which the approximate real rate does not
